title: STEMEd+ Professional Learning: a program
description: One national professional learning program for K-12 teachers or informal educators, with any announced sessions or application rounds. One file per program in programs/. List only programs run by a national scholarly or professional society or association (US or international), by a US federal agency, or by a national program funded by a US federal agency. State, regional, and district programs are not listed, and neither are programs run by companies or funded only by private foundations. If you are not sure a program meets that rule, leave it out.

name.description: Program name as the provider gives it.

providers.description: The societies, associations, or agencies that run or fund it.

sponsor_type.description: US society: a national US scholarly or professional society or association. International society: one organized internationally. US federal agency: run by NOAA, NASA, NSF, NPS, the Department of Energy, or another US agency. Federally funded program: a national program run by another organization with US federal funding (say how in funding_note).

funding_note.description: Which agency supports it and how.

type.description: research: a research experience in a lab or field team. field: a field, ship, or park experience. fellowship: a paid, full-time placement. institute: an in-person or live workshop or summer institute. course: an online or blended course. webinars: a series of live webinars. coaching: one-on-one or team coaching or mentoring. credential: training that leads to a certification.

audiences.description: Informal educators: museum, zoo, aquarium, park, nature center, library, after-school, and outreach educators.

grades.description: Grade bands it is designed for. Leave empty if it is for all of K-12, or only for informal educators.

disciplines.description: Labels from the STEMEd+ discipline list (stemed_pl/stemedplus_disciplines.json, kept in HuMeta). Leave empty for programs open to all STEM+ fields. Computer science is listed under Engineering.

cost.description: free: no cost to participants. stipend: no cost, and participants are paid or have travel covered. members: free for members of the society. fee: participants or their schools pay. varies: depends on the session or host.

cost_note.description: Amounts, what is covered, or member prices, in a sentence.

credit.description: Graduate credit, certificates of hours, or certification, in a sentence.

url.description: The provider's page for the program.

status.description: paused: the provider says it is not running now.

status_note.description: Why it is paused and when the provider expects news.

schedule.description: When it usually happens and when applications are usually due, in a sentence.

summary.description: Who it is for and what participants do, in your own words.

checked.description: When someone last checked this file against the provider's pages.

notes.description: Notes for maintainers; not shown on the site.

offerings.description: Announced sessions, cohorts, or application rounds. Past ones may stay; the site hides them once every date has passed.

dates_source.description: official: the dates are on the provider's own page for this offering. announced: the provider gave a month or season, or a partner announced it.

label.description: e.g. Applications open, Applications due, Registration closes.
